what: The steps by which benchmarks/s10/records.yaml changed after the tool records cited it (S10 spec §17 A4-3, R-721). Each step changes one line, `<key>: <JSON string>`; tests/test_s10_records.py::test_records_lineage_reconstructs_the_cited_hashes walks the steps back from HEAD and rebuilds the hashes the tool records cite.

steps.to_value: Validation (S10 spec §9.6; docs/s10-validation-report.md): VAL-1 within band (38 held-out ternary points, 101.3 kPa, 339.7-368.0 K: AAD(T) 0.21 K, AAD(y) <= 0.0057, max |dy| 0.021). VAL-3: latent heat of methanol not validated within band (+5.72 % at T_b(101325 Pa) against 5 %, from the ideal-gas vapour); ethanol and water latent heats and all liquid c_p within band, the c_p low by up to 19.7 % (methanol). VAL-2 (constant Lambda off the 101.3 kPa isobar) pending: no data. The methanol-ethanol Lambda are individually undetermined by the binary data; the fit's second minimum moves ternary bubble temperatures by up to 0.46 K (S10 spec §17 A4-2).
steps.commit: recorded by the next commit (S10_DECISIONS B-80)
